subject: QA5 'Inform' (imgllc, design_id 13406389) '320x225 canvas' claim is a HARNESS ARTIFACT, not a bug
verdict: b+c — the QA5 harness imported/opened the WRONG design (title-substring collision), and the reference thumb is that other design's image, not a render of 13406389.

root_cause.harness_bug: scripts/e2e-qa5.mjs matches grid/dashboard cards with `(el.textContent||'').includes(title)`. The pick title is the bare string 'Inform', which is a substring of two OTHER designs on the same imgllc account.
root_cause.consequence: Every `.includes('Inform')` lookup in qa5 (thumb capture, checkbox tick, dashboard open) resolved to the DOM-first card 'InformationImage320X225' — a genuine 320x225 landscape image design whose name literally states its size. So qa5/imgllc-inform-thumb.png and qa5/imgllc-inform-canvas.png are BOTH InformationImage320X225, NOT design 13406389.

real_inform_13406389_evidence.payload_canvasData: width=1000 height=1000, one clipart (pencil icon-UZiDTv.svg), matrix scale 1.5209 -> ~389x389 centered at (500,482)
real_inform_13406389_evidence.screenshot: ../final-2/imgllc-Inform-REAL-canvas.png (1000x1000 square, small centered pencil on white — correct)
real_inform_13406389_evidence.matches: the earlier Opus agent's live-pipeline finding (opened 1000x1000, not reproducible)

InformationImage320X225_13626390.screenshot: ../final-2/imgllc-InformationImage320X225-canvas.png (landscape pencil filling frame — identical to the mislabeled qa5 imgllc-inform-canvas.png)

conclusion: No product/import bug for 'Inform'. The import path renders design 13406389 correctly at 1000x1000. The qa5 '320x225' reference and canvas are the unrelated 'InformationImage320X225' design pulled in by a substring-match bug in the test harness (which matches by non-unique title text). Not release-blocking.
